text:
maya: Quick sync dropped a compact Figma update for the autoscale panel. Need feedback on: pool badges, stepper behavior, and the new suggestion banner. https://www.figma.com/file/zzz/autoscale-compact kevin: nice. banner is clear but we should avoid auto-changing values. show suggestion buttons instead. olivia: accessibility: make banner tabbable and announce via role="alert". also chip helper text contrast is low (2.7:1). sam: research note: testers expect one-click fixes. label buttons explicitly: "Lower Max to 8" / "Pick different pool". jordan: stepper: change to step=1, add aria-live polite region, and increase focus ring to 4px. hold-to-repeat should accelerate after 400ms. maya: agree on stepper. kevin, can you add GPU family badge (A100) on chips so users don't confuse pools? kevin: yeah adding small badge + tooltip "A100". will also include region label. olivia: SLO label needs to be explicit: "Latency SLO (p90)" with tooltip: "Lower values may increase cost." maya: decision list: 1) Min/Max copy tweak 2) Stepper accessibility 3) Banner with apply/dismiss 4) Chip badges 5) Inline cost hint toggle sam: QA will test keyboard-only flow: tab to pool, change, tab to banner, activate suggestion. jordan: aria snippet for banner group:
...buttons...
maya: timeline: ship stepper + banner + badges this sprint, SLO cost toggle next sprint. Olivia will run contrast pass. kevin: opening draft PR now. olivia: posting contrast screenshots shortly. sam: adding test cases to AUTOSCALE-4872. maya: thanks all. I'll pin the a11y checklist in Figma and tag for review.
